author: James Bruton
description:
#ad The @LEGO Group sent me a bunch of the new LEGO Star Wars SMART Play sets to take a look at. The new SMART Bricks have lots of features packed into them, and they don’t use any screens or apps. The SMART Bricks charge wirelessly and power up when you shake them. The main functions are activated when SMART Tags or SMART Minifigures are placed near them, and the sounds are synthesized which means the same SMART Bricks can be used for other themes in the future. 
#LEGOPartner #SMARTPlay #TheGalaxyPlayBack #LEGOStarWars
title: LEGO Star Wars SMART Play
